programs.description: A patriarch of a royal family goes on a mission to find the murderers responsible for killing his descendant. He takes the help of his nephews who are police officers.
Joji, a motorcycle enthusiast, is the youngest son of a well-known man named Kora Sahib. When Joji is falsely accused of murder, he tries to prove his innocence with the support of his father.
On his grandfather's request, Paramu decides to visit his ancestral village in order to recover a sacred ornament. His quest brings him face-to-face with his uncle, who killed his father.
A filmmaker is found dead under mysterious circumstances. Years later, his son, Adi, a successful writer, digs into his past and tries to demystify the reason for his father's death.
A dynastic struggle between the collateral branches of the Kuru clan, the Kauravas and Pandavas, for the throne of Hastinapur leads to the Kurukshetra War.
Distinguished artists and musicians present enchanting performances interpreting the rich culture of India during the 2025 edition of the Soorya Festival.
Anjana, a doctor, thinks that silence is golden and avoids speaking much, whereas Arvind, a salesman, loves talking. Their lives change when a strange disease called 'dumb flu' spreads in the city.
Prasanth is a mechanic and is best friends with Freddy. One day, they come across a girl, whose extended family is chasing her for her inherited wealth, and try to save her.
Venu, the owner of a small-scale finance firm, loses his son in an unfortunate incident. He gets involved in a lot of social work that soon leads him to become an obstacle in the way of his rivals.
Vishnu gets acquainted with Raghu during a trip and learns that he is rich and is returning home after 16 years. Then, Vishnu pushes Raghu into a ravine and goes to his house pretending to be him.
The lives of a childless and elderly couple take a drastic turn when the young daughter of a family friend comes to live with them.
